# Load data and prep
```{r}
# Load data
load(params$input)

# Create separate data sets for analysis 
otu <- data.frame(otu_table(phy))
meta <- data.frame(sample_data(phy))
met_labels <- readxl::read_xlsx(metabolomics_labels, sheet = 'metadata')

## Note you can use the below to read in metabolomics data if not already merged in gmh_metadata_import ##
# Import metadata with rownames that match phyloseq object 
# met <- read.csv2(metabolomics_data, sep = ",", header = T, row.names = 1)


# Extract metabolites from metadata 
metabolites_to_keep <- met_labels$Name
met <- meta %>% select(all_of(metabolites_to_keep))

# Remove metabolites from metadataframe
meta <- meta %>% select(-metabolites_to_keep)

# Check data all contains the same data
samples_all <- Reduce(intersect, list(rownames(meta), rownames(otu), rownames(met)))
stopifnot(length(samples_all) > 0)

# Align row order across dataframes 
ord <- rownames(meta)
otu <- otu[ord, , drop = FALSE]
met <- met[ord, , drop = FALSE]

# Get fearture sets and labels 
tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy))
taxa <- tax_df$Species
metabolites <- met_labels$Name

## Microbiome preperation ##
otu_mat <- as.matrix(otu)
row_sums <- rowSums(otu_mat)
if (any(row_sums == 0)){
  warning('Some samples have zero total counts; adding a small psuedocount.')
  otu_mat[row_sums ==0,] <- otu_mat[row_sums == 0,] + 1L
  row_sums <- rowSums(otu_mat)
}

otu_prop <- sweep(otu_mat, 1, row_sums, "/")


# CLR transformation with small psuedocount (better for compositional analysis) 
pseudocount <- 0.5
logp <- log(otu_prop + pseudocount / row_sums)
clr_center <- rowMeans(logp)
otu_clr <- sweep(logp, 1, clr_center, "-")

## Metabolite preperation ##
# Keep only the metabolite column

met_mat <- met %>% select(any_of(metabolites)) %>% as.matrix()

# Log transform data 
met_log <- log1p(met_mat)
met_scaled <- scale(met_log)

scfa_df <- met_labels %>% filter(set == 'SCFA')
scfa_names <- scfa_df$Name
ba_df <- met_labels %>% filter(set == 'BA')
ba_names <- ba_df$Name


# SCFA composite: (Acetate + Propionate + Butyrate) - (Isobutyrate + Isovalerate) - change names as needed
scfa_cols <- intersect(colnames(met_mat), c("Acetic_acid","Propanoic_acid","Butanoic_acid","n2_methyl_propanoic_acid","n3_methylbutanoic_acid"))
stopifnot(all(c("Acetic_acid","Propanoic_acid","Butanoic_acid","n2_methyl_propanoic_acid","n3_methylbutanoic_acid") %in% scfa_cols))
scfa_score <- with(as.data.frame(met_mat),
  Acetic_acid + Propanoic_acid + 1.3*Butanoic_acid - (n2_methyl_propanoic_acid + n3_methylbutanoic_acid)
)
scfa_score_z <- as.numeric(scale(scfa_score))

met_bc <- met_scaled


```


# Create master objects and long forms for plotting 
```{r}

# Master objects 
X_micro_clr <- otu_clr
X_metab_bc <- met_bc

meta$barcode <- rownames(meta)
tax_df$otu <- rownames(tax_df)


# Long form for plotting

micro_long <- as_tibble(X_micro_clr, rownames = "sample_id")%>% 
  pivot_longer(-sample_id, names_to = "feature", values_to = "clr_abundance") %>%
  left_join(meta, by = c('sample_id' = 'barcode')) %>%
  left_join(tax_df %>% select("otu","Species"), by = c("feature" = "otu"))
  
metab_long <- as_tibble(X_metab_bc, rownames = "sample_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample_id, names_to = "metabolite", values_to = "scaled_values") %>%
  left_join(meta, by = c("sample_id" = "barcode")) %>%
  left_join(met_labels %>% select("Name", "set"), by = c("metabolite" = "Name"))

# Add scores to metadata 

meta_enhanced <- meta %>% mutate(scfa_scores = scfa_score_z) 


# Quick sanity checks 
message("Samples per group:")
print(table(meta_enhanced$PFOS_level))

message("SCFA score by group (mean ±sd):")
print(meta_enhanced %>% group_by(PFOS_level) %>% 
        summarise(mean = mean(scfa_scores), sd = sd(scfa_scores), .groups = "drop"))

# Save as R_object 
save(meta, meta_enhanced, met_labels, X_micro_clr, X_metab_bc, micro_long, metab_long, file = "R_objects/prepared_objects.RData")

# Slim csv based on SFA scores 

meta_enhanced %>% select(SampleID, barcode, alder, sex_calc, PFOS_stool, PFOS_level, scfa_scores) %>% write.csv(file = "output/sample_level_scores.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# clear the environment and release memory
rm(list = ls(all.names = TRUE))
invisible(gc())


```

# Dimension reduction and multivariate analysis for each omics 

## Plotting function for data -  Update group variable as needed.
```{r}
plot_xy <- function(df, x, y){
  ggplot(df, aes(.data[[x]], .data[[y]], colour = group, fill = group)) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = group),
               geom = "polygon", type = "norm", level = 0.68,
               alpha = 0.3, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6)+
    geom_point(size = 2.6, alpha = 0.95) +
    scale_color_earth15(name = "group")+
    scale_fill_earth15(name = "group") +
    labs(x =x, y=y) +
    theme_minimal()
  
}

```

## Microbiome analysis 
```{r}

# PCoA on Aitchinson distance (Euclidean on CLR)
d_ait <- dist(X_micro_clr, method = "euclidean")
fit_pcoa <- cmdscale(d_ait, k = 3, eig = TRUE)
df_pcoa_micro <- tibble(PCo1 = fit_pcoa$points[,1],
                        PCo2 = fit_pcoa$points[,2],
                        PCo3 = fit_pcoa$points[,3],
                        sample_id = meta_enhanced$SampleID,
                        group = meta_enhanced$PFOS_level)
# Percent variance (positive eigenvalues only)
evals <- fit_pcoa$eig; pve <- evals[evals>0]/sum(evals[evals>0])
p2 <- plot_xy(df_pcoa_micro, "PCo1", "PCo2")
p2
#ggsave("plots/high_res/pcoa_microbiome_aitchison.png", p2, width = 6.5, height = 5, dpi = 900)
#write.csv(df_pcoa_micro, "output/pcoa_microbiome_coords.csv", row.names = FALSE)


# UMAP (on CLR)
set.seed(123)
U_micro <- umap(X_micro_clr, n_neighbors = 15, min_dist = 0.15, metric = "euclidean")
df_umap_micro <- tibble(UMAP1 = U_micro[,1], UMAP2 = U_micro[,2],
                        sample_id = meta$SampleID, group = meta_enhanced$PFOS_level)
p3 <- plot_xy(df_umap_micro, "UMAP1", "UMAP2")
ggsave("plots/high_res/umap_microbiome.png", p3, width = 6.5, height = 5, dpi = 300)
write.csv(df_umap_micro, "output/umap_microbiome_coords.csv", row.names = FALSE)
p3


```

## Statistical correaltion 
```{r}

results <- data.frame(OTU = unique(micro_long$feature))

species_list <- unique(micro_long$feature)

df <- as.data.frame(X_micro_clr)

results$rho <- sapply(species_list, function(sp) {
  cor(df[[sp]], meta_enhanced$PFOS_stool, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
})

results$p.value <- sapply(species_list, function(sp) {
  cor.test(df[[sp]], meta_enhanced$PFOS_stool, method = "spearman")$p.value
})

# Adjust for FDR
results$FDR <- p.adjust(results$p.value, method = "fdr")

# Order by FDR (optional)
results <- results[order(results$FDR), ]

results

sig_before <- subset(results, p.value < 0.05)
sig_after <- subset(results, FDR < 0.05)
nrow(sig_before)
nrow(sig_after)


high_corr <-subset(results,
                       p.value < 0.05 &
                       (rho < -0.35 | rho > 0.35))
```

## Correlation plot with added stats
```{r}
# Check inputs
A <- micro_filt       # samples x taxa
B <- X_metab_bc       # samples x metabolites



# Optional: drop non-numeric columns safely
A <- A[, vapply(as.data.frame(A), is.numeric, logical(1)), drop = FALSE]
B <- B[, vapply(as.data.frame(B), is.numeric, logical(1)), drop = FALSE]

# Optional: remove underscores and replace with spaces from feature labels 
tmp <- as.data.frame(B)
colnames(tmp) <- gsub("_", " ", colnames(tmp))
B <- as.matrix(tmp)


#Compute Spearmans correlations (pairwise complete) 
cor_micro_met <- suppressWarnings(cor(A, B, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))

# Update plot to include species names 
corr_df <- as.data.frame(cor_micro_met)
corr_df$OTU <- rownames(corr_df)
tmp <- micro_long[c("feature", "Species")] %>% distinct(feature, .keep_all = TRUE)
corr_df <-merge(corr_df, tmp, by.x = "OTU", by.y = "feature", all.x = TRUE, all.y = FALSE)
rownames(corr_df) <- corr_df$Species
drops <- c("OTU", "Species")
corr_df <- corr_df[, !names(corr_df) %in% drops]
rownames(corr_df) <- trimws(rownames(corr_df))

# Change the names of specific features 
rownames(corr_df)[rownames(corr_df) == "Blautia_A wexlerae"] <- "Blautia luti"


cor_micro_met<- as.matrix(corr_df)

# Compute Spearmans p-values per cell 
spearman_p_matrix <- function(A, B) {
  nA <- ncol(A); nB <- ncol(B)
  p_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nA, ncol = nB,
                  dimnames = list(colnames(A), colnames(B)))
  # Loop over columns (features) – clear & robust
  for (i in seq_len(nA)) {
    x <- A[, i]
    for (j in seq_len(nB)) {
      y <- B[, j]
      ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
      if (sum(ok) >= 3) {
        # exact=FALSE avoids very slow exact computation for larger n
        s <- try(suppressWarnings(cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)),
                 silent = TRUE)
        p_mat[i, j] <- if (inherits(s, "try-error")) NA_real_ else s$p.value
      } else {
        p_mat[i, j] <- NA_real_
      }
    }
  }
  p_mat
}

p_mat <- spearman_p_matrix(A, B)

# FDR correction across all cells tested 
q_vec <- p.adjust(as.vector(p_mat), method = "fdr")
q_mat <- matrix(q_vec, nrow = nrow(p_mat), ncol = ncol(p_mat),
                dimnames = dimnames(p_mat))

# Convert FDR to significance stars 
fdr_to_stars <- function(q) {
  ifelse(!is.finite(q), "",
  ifelse(q < 0.001, "***",
  ifelse(q < 0.01,  "**",
  ifelse(q < 0.05,  "*", ""))))
}
star_mat <- matrix(fdr_to_stars(as.vector(q_mat)),
                   nrow = nrow(q_mat), ncol = ncol(q_mat),
                   dimnames = dimnames(q_mat))

# Optionally show stars only where q < 0.05:
star_mat_sig <- ifelse(q_mat < 0.05, star_mat, "")

# Plot heatmap with stars overlaid
A_plot <- pheatmap(
  cor_micro_met,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#3885B6","white","#FA7F2E"))(50),
  #main = "Microbiome (CLR taxa) vs Metabolites",
  fontsize_row = 6, fontsize_col = 8,
  clustering_method = "complete",
  display_numbers = star_mat_sig,   # <- significance overlay
  number_color = "black",
   fontsize_number = 8,
  border_color = NA
)

ggsave("plots/high_res/subset1_SIGNIF_metab_micro_correlation.png", A_plot, width = 25, height = 12, dpi = 1200)
```
